- Sadness

- Anger

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
toh fa yau kuma me ya shiga tsakanin da har yake furta wannan kalamai ba ya fatan sake ganawa da mutum kamar buhari

output.disgust: toh fa yau, me ya shafi wannan mutum har yake furta wannan kalamai? Ni ba na jin dadin cewa ba ya fatan sake ganawa da mutum kamar Buhari!
